title: VIXEN Release configure requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT override
body: The documented VIXEN Release build fails before compilation when UNDERTOW_ROOT is unset because libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt requires generated text shader interfaces; supplying the paired Undertow checkout manually unblocks configure. Suggested consolidation: make the build preset resolve or declare the paired Undertow/schema root through the facade/codegen contract.

title: Capture queue wrapper needs documented systemd-run and env ordering
body: GPU witness attempts first failed before launch because systemd-run --wait was combined with --scope, and env placed -u after an assignment; the successful queued form uses --scope --collect and places env removals before assignments. Suggested consolidation: provide a tested capture wrapper that owns the memory-capped systemd invocation and environment ordering.

title: VIXEN codegen materialization emits Roslyn locale warnings
body: The documented CMake codegen materialization succeeds but emits repeated NETSDK1188 warnings for Microsoft.CodeAnalysis resource locales before generating shader faces. Suggested consolidation: make the VIXEN codegen target pin or suppress the package locale assets so a clean generation witness is warning-free.
